verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents two public APIs on its developer site. The Marketing API covers a discoverable API root, contact creation, campaign sending and account export, and the Transactional (Mandrill) API covers SMS, routes, allowlists and dedicated IPs; webhooks for both cover event-driven agent workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API in practice, since all evidence is first-party.
